runs.said: I can hear it, but I can't see it. It's ringing a little to my right, where I'm pointing: it may be under something.
runs.why: the robot's microphones heard the ringing a little to my right (3 turns); SAM 3.1 looked there

runs.said: I followed the ringing. There it is! I see your computer monitor, a little to my right, about 3 feet away.
runs.why: the robot's microphones heard the ringing a little to my right (4 turns); SAM 3.1 looked there
